faqs.q: Will SEO bring me the right style of clients, or just anyone?
faqs.a: The right ones, because style pages filter for you. A client who lands on your blackwork page and books a consultation already wants blackwork. That is the whole point of style-led SEO: it pre-qualifies clients before they ever message you, so you spend less time declining mismatched projects.

faqs.q: How long does tattoo SEO take?
faqs.a: Style pages can start ranking within two to four months in most cities, because competition for specific styles is thinner than you would expect. Most studios never built these pages, so the field is open. Broader terms take longer, but the style pages are where the dream clients come from anyway.

faqs.q: I am already fully booked. Why would I need SEO?
faqs.a: Two reasons: selectivity and security. Selectivity means a waitlist of ideal projects instead of whoever walks in, so you can raise rates and choose work you love. Security means the bookings keep coming when Instagram reach dips or a slow season hits. Fully booked today is the best time to build the pipeline.

faqs.q: Do I still need Instagram if my site ranks?
faqs.a: Yes, they do different jobs. Instagram is your living portfolio and where clients check you are active. Google is where new clients with intent find you. The artists winning right now run both: Instagram for proof of life, search for a steady flow of consultations.

faqs.q: Can SEO help with flash days and events?
faqs.a: Absolutely. A dedicated page for a flash day captures timely searches and gives people something to share and link to. Single flash day pages have pulled in dozens of bookings, because nobody else in the city bothers to build one.

faqs.q: My studio has several artists. Should each have their own page?
faqs.a: Yes. Each resident artist deserves a dedicated page with their style, healed portfolio, and booking path. These pages rank for style-plus-city searches and for the artist's name, turning your roster into a set of landing pages instead of a single staff list.
